residual_risks: Ordinary pane wheel scroll remains failed in native Windows + WezTerm + rmux foreground retest.
Current mouse on policy routes pane wheel events through application mouse reporting, so WezTerm GUI-native scroll is not proven by rmux binding snapshots or negative scroll assertions.

Changing the result from blocked to pass requires an approved strategy and fresh foreground validation: tmux/rmux-like copy-mode scroll, host terminal native scroll with mouse reporting off or modifier bypass, or a clearly scoped pane-app passthrough route.

ordinary_pane_wheel_scroll.failure_detail: No approved default route currently lets ordinary pane wheel produce visible scroll while keeping existing Windows/rmux policy unchanged.
